name: stillshard-strike-prepare-1-declined-no-recover
notes: Stillshard Strike (TDI5DOrWB5, WATER ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 2, printed power 3): "Prepare 1. On Attack: If Stillshard Strike was prepared, recover 1+X, where X is the total amount of sheen counters on each defending unit." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Player 2's champion starts with 6 damage; player 1's champion carries 2 sheen counters (X = 2), so a prepared attack recovers 1+2 = 3. Player 2 declines Prepare 1: no recovery (6 damage stays), 3 damage dealt, counter untouched.

rulesClauses: On Attack: If Stillshard Strike was prepared, recover 1+X, where X is the total amount of sheen counters on each defending unit.
